title: Getting Error 400 / 404 on Payment Endpoint
details:
URL: https://stage.api.kodacars.com:32783/customer-service/api/Payment/ReservationPayment
Method: POST | Status: 400 Bad Request
Steps:
1. Create reservation -> 2. Scroll down
3. Click collect payment (Cash/Card)
4. Comment anything -> 5. Click collect money
notes: Rate limit issue: occurs when system receives multiple requests under 38 seconds.
